http.instructions: Send JSON {tool, arguments}. HTTP retry identity belongs in the Idempotency-Key header, never arguments.idempotency_key; MCP uses idempotency_key inside its tool arguments.

arguments_schema.description: Preview a flow with fixtures. Returns simulated, status, steps and would. No device actions or paid calls.

trigger.description: Example event values available to trigger references

flow.description: An inline workflow.validate definition with name, trigger and steps

fixtures.description: Synthetic results keyed by group and step id, e.g. photos.shot, ask_model.look and ask_owner.check. Omit fixtures for skipped steps
